typePolicy.digests: Explicit algorithm/domain/version; a hash/digest/checksum name alone is insufficient.
typePolicy.constraints: PK/UNIQUE/FK/CHECK/index/trigger parity remains a separate D1 compatibility test gate.

R-EMAIL-EXT.reason: Direct contact PII; keep raw value in separately approved PII custody, not D1/Worker payload/logs.

R-MESSAGE-EXT.reason: Free-text PII; keep raw message in separately approved PII custody.

R-SUBSCRIPTION-URL-EXT.reason: Secret-bearing subscription URL; never enter D1, Worker payloads, or logs.

R-TOTP-EXT.reason: Even encrypted TOTP blobs remain outside D1; retain credential identity/status/counters only.

R-PAYMENT-ACTION-EXT.reason: Provider action URL may contain bearer/signed query data; use short-lived custody.

R-LEGACY-CHECKOUT-EXT.reason: Legacy checkout URL may be an active payment capability.

R-LEGACY-QR-EXT.reason: QR payload may encode a payment capability.

R-LEASE-DIGEST.reason: Replace raw short-lived capability with a domain-separated digest; preserve generation, expiry, state guards and fencing.
R-LEASE-DIGEST.condition: Verify every producer issues cryptographically random 32-byte tokens; current contract is 64 lowercase hex and relevant claim code uses randomBytes(32).

R-IDEMPOTENCY-HMAC.reason: Replace raw idempotency key with a versioned domain-separated HMAC digest; preserve actor/operation scope and replay conflict semantics.
R-IDEMPOTENCY-HMAC.transform: HMAC-SHA-256 with versioned dedicated key and domain prefix flylink:d1:idempotency:v1
R-IDEMPOTENCY-HMAC.condition: Migration runner and Worker must use the same versioned HMAC key via secret custody; no key in D1, source, logs, or Notion.

R-PROVIDER-EVENT-HMAC.reason: Treat provider event dedupe token as potentially replayable capability until provider contract proves it is a non-sensitive stable identifier.
R-PROVIDER-EVENT-HMAC.transform: HMAC-SHA-256 with versioned provider-event domain key
R-PROVIDER-EVENT-HMAC.condition: Provider contract may downgrade to opaque stable ID only with documented evidence.

R-METADATA-JSON.reason: JSON may contain PII, credentials, URLs, raw material or arbitrary free text; only a versioned recursive allowlist is permitted.
R-METADATA-JSON.transform: canonical JSON + field-specific versioned recursive allowlist; reject unknown and unsafe keys/values
R-METADATA-JSON.condition: Define exact JSON schema per field; assertNoUnsafeFields is not a whole-table guarantee.
R-METADATA-JSON.v22Note: V2.2（P2 Option A）：本规则 4 行里只有 platform_accounts.metadata_json 一行暂不建列、不加载（见 v22.exclusions）；其余 3 行不受影响。

R-CONTROLLED-JSON.reason: Snapshot or controlled policy JSON may be retained only under a versioned schema and strict allowlist.
R-CONTROLLED-JSON.transform: canonical JSON + schema validation + recursive secret/PII rejection

R-PUBLIC-JWK-DEFER.reason: Future passkey data is not active; public-key JWK only may be reconsidered later.
R-PUBLIC-JWK-DEFER.condition: Dedicated WebAuthn contract; allow public JWK members only and reject private member d.

R-ADS-CONDITIONAL.reason: Lazy feature-gated Ads Consent schema; not an unconditional part of the production source table set.
R-ADS-CONDITIONAL.condition: Require ADS_CLICK_BINDING_ENABLED and independently verified production presence; establish versioned baseline fingerprint first.
R-ADS-CONDITIONAL.v22Note: V2.2（P6）：8 行 stays CONDITIONAL。功能门默认关闭（adsBindingEnabled 只认 "true"/true，ads-conversion-store.mjs:50-53；仓库测试 33/33 通过）；ad_personalization=0 结构性约束保留；剩余门：功能门决定 + 源指纹确认 + #816 生产归因门禁。

R-ARCHIVE-CONDITIONAL.reason: Legacy archive forms only when exact old platform_payment_orders schema fingerprint matches.

R-REFERRAL-CODE-CONDITIONAL.reason: User-facing referral code may be a public opaque code or bearer-like capability.

R-REFERRAL-CODE-CONDITIONAL.v22Note: V2.2（P6）：精确 schema + allowlist + 负向测试已完成，见 fieldContracts；剩余门是域负责人确认公开推荐码不属于秘密能力。

R-SAFE-REASON-CONDITIONAL.reason: Field may contain free text; target accepts only safe enumerated reason/purpose codes.
R-SAFE-REASON-CONDITIONAL.condition: Require code allowlist and reject arbitrary text; otherwise transform to safe code or externalize raw text.
R-SAFE-REASON-CONDITIONAL.v22Note: V2.2（P6）：4 行精确 schema + allowlist + 负向测试已完成，见 fieldContracts；reason/revocation_reason 写入口已有模式强制，notifications.reason 与 issuance purpose 须迁移门校验。

R-URL-EXT.reason: URLs may carry bearer tokens or signed query parameters.
R-URL-EXT.replacement: opaque short-lived URL/action reference; raw URL never in D1 or logs.

R-FREE-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.reason: Potential free text or identifying data.
R-FREE-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.condition: Keep only a controlled enum/safe code; do not migrate arbitrary user text.
R-FREE-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.v22Note: V2.2（P6）：剩 1 行（jobs.failure_reason），精确 schema + allowlist + 负向测试已完成，见 fieldContracts；转 KEEP 的门是写入口/迁移门执行模式 + 域负责人确认。

R-DIGEST-KEEP.reason: Already a digest/checksum field; verify algorithm, domain, canonicalization and absence of raw source value.

R-OPAQUE-REF-KEEP.reason: Retain only as opaque reference; reject email, username, URL, absolute path, bearer token, raw UUID/password or material.
R-OPAQUE-REF-KEEP.condition: Validate opaque reference grammar and ownership; re-issue stable opaque refs if source value is not opaque.

R-UNMAPPED-JSON-CONDITIONAL.reason: JSON semantics are not covered by the current explicit allowlist.
R-UNMAPPED-JSON-CONDITIONAL.condition: Do not include until field-specific versioned schema and recursive safe-value allowlist are documented.

R-TIME-KEEP.reason: Preserve source time representation; do not globally coerce text ISO timestamps to integers.
R-TIME-KEEP.condition: Preserve epoch-millisecond INTEGER where source type is INTEGER; otherwise validate canonical UTC ISO text and source precision.

R-BOOL-KEEP.reason: Keep SQLite INTEGER 0/1; preserve/add explicit CHECK (value IN (0,1)).

R-INTEGER-KEEP.reason: Keep INTEGER with safe-integer bounds and source-specific sign/range invariants.

R-ENUM-KEEP.reason: Keep TEXT only with exact enum/safe-code allowlist; reject unbounded free text.

R-CURATED-COPY-KEEP.reason: Curated operator-controlled product copy; validate length and reject secrets, URLs, PII and unsafe markup.

R-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.reason: Text semantics are not sufficiently constrained by a field-specific allowlist.
R-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.condition: Keep only after domain owner confirms opaque reference, enum or safe bounded text contract.
R-TEXT-CONDITIONAL.v22Note: V2.2（P6）：唯一行 generation 已转 KEEP，本规则暂无行，保留供以后未映射文本字段用（同 R-UNMAPPED-JSON-CONDITIONAL 在 V2.1 的做法）。

designNotes: Raw lead email/message, subscription URL, encrypted TOTP blob, provider next-action URL, legacy checkout URL/QR and edge credential-material files remain outside D1.
All raw lease_token columns become lease_token_hash using SHA-256 with a domain prefix; generation, lease_until, state guards and fencing remain unchanged.
Raw idempotency keys become versioned domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 digests; key custody is a separate security design and no key is provisioned here.
metadata_json/event_json/payload_json are transformed via exact recursive allowlists; controlled snapshots/policies are kept only after schema validation.
Usage samples require finite retention/aggregation decision; Ads Consent and legacy archive remain conditional; password/passkey data remain deferred.
platform_schema_migrations and Wrangler d1_migrations coexist as separate ledgers; schemaDigest, not PRAGMA schema_version, is schema identity.
Payment remains multi-stage saga/reconciliation; subscription fulfillment crosses D1/BWH with durable command/receipt; Deferred remains single-D1 atomic + Lease/outbox.
issuer_ref is an enum ('portal','admin') naming the surface, not an IdP issuer URL; subject_ref is the IdP opaque subject, no raw PII is stored in platform_identity_bindings.

The 6 new JSON columns (jobs.scope_json, jobs.steps_json, proofs.scope_json, proofs.verification_json, proofs.deferred_scope_json, tombstones.retained_categories_json) are CONDITIONAL under R-IDENTITY-DELETION-JSON-CONDITIONAL: each has a source-determined element contract in this file's jsonContracts (machine-readable keys added in V2.2/P6), but the store writer jsonArray() still only checks Array.isArray, so the contract is enforced only in the service layer. KEEP requires a writer test pinning the contract (M1-11 second half); deferred_scope_json and retained_categories_json additionally await the C5 retention decision.
retention_policy_ref currently carries the literal marker 'pending-c5-decision'; its vocabulary becomes meaningful only after the C5 formal decision (M1-08).

platform_identity_bindings.account_id has ON DELETE RESTRICT: a physical account delete is blocked from the first binding row unless revoke-then-delete binding cleanup precedes it (B2-b design, implemented in #883).

V2.2（P2 Option A）：platform_accounts.metadata_json 处置仍为 TRANSFORM，但 T3 DDL 草案 2026-11-16 版暂不建此列——措辞“暂不建列、不加载”在处置（本文件 v22.exclusions + 该行 v22Note）与 T3 DDL（表头注释 + 排除清单）两端一致，互相写明对方文件。M1-02 关闭前不得建列、不得加载现有值。

V2.2（P6）：platform_edge_desired_state_notifications.generation 与 platform_coin_holds.purpose 由 CONDITIONAL 转 KEEP（写入口已有精确强制 + 负向测试全过，见 fieldContracts）；其余 7 行精确 schema/allowlist 已完成，仍为 CONDITIONAL，剩余门见 fieldContracts.remainingGate。
V2.2（P5）：23 行 DEFER（密码 11 + passkey 12）逐行核对无变；现有密码登录仍走本地凭据表，不依赖 D1 凭据列；生产密码格式盘点未做，另走授权门。

platform_identity_deletion_jobs.scope_js.storage: TEXT, JSON array, NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
platform_identity_deletion_jobs.scope_js.lengthRange: 3–8 个元素（至少含 account、credentials、sessions 三个必备类；无重复）
platform_identity_deletion_jobs.scope_js.contract: 字符串数组，元素只能是 8 个删除范围类别之一；无重复；必须包含 account、credentials、sessions。写入口先经服务层 #validateScope 校验（非空、无重复、元素在白名单内、必备三类齐全），再经 jsonArray() 只验 Array.isArray 后 JSON.stringify 入库。读入口 JSON.parse 后直接取用，无元素校验。
platform_identity_deletion_jobs.scope_js.enforcedAt: 只在服务层强制（portal-identity-deletion.mjs #validateScope）；store 层 jsonArray() 只验 Array.isArray，直接写库可绕过。
openItems: deferred 类别（entitlements/entries/recommendations/coin/ads）的保留处理等 C5 正式决定；元素词表本身已定。

platform_identity_deletion_jobs.steps_js.storage: TEXT, JSON array, NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
platform_identity_deletion_jobs.steps_js.lengthRange: 恰好 9 个元素，下标 = 步骤号 0–8，与 IDENTITY_DELETION_STEPS 一一对应
platform_identity_deletion_jobs.steps_js.contract: 对象数组，每元素 {step: 整数 0–8（=下标）, name: 9 个步骤名之一（persist_request / freeze_account / revoke_sessions / revoke_credentials / d1_placeholder / delete_personal_data / write_tombstone / verify_readback / issue_proof）, status: pending|completed|failed, completedAt: ISO-8601 字符串或 null, failureReason: 字符串或 null, retryCount: ≥0 整数, eventRef: 安全引用字符串或 null, counts: 对象或 null}。counts 的键按步骤不同，是开放词表、值一律为非负整数（已观测：step1 accountFrozen；step2 sessionRevoked/sessionTotal；step3 pwdRevoked/totpRevoked/passkeyRevoked/bindingRevoked/bindingDeleted/bindingCleanupSkipped(0/1)；step4 d1RecordsSkipped；step5 物理 pwdDeleted/totpDeleted/passkeyDeleted/sessionDeleted/challengeDeleted/entryDeleted/accountRowDeleted，逻辑 metadataFieldsStripped；step6 tombstoneWritten(0/1)；step7 assertionsPassed；step8 proofIssued(0/1)；step0 counts 为 null）。
platform_identity_deletion_jobs.steps_js.enforcedAt: 形状由 initialSteps() 生成、#executeStep 逐项更新；store 层 jsonArray() 只验 Array.isArray，不验元素。
openItems: counts 的键是按步骤开放的词表：新增步骤会带新键，writer 测试须按“值一律为非负整数”断言而非枚举全部键。

platform_identity_deletion_proofs.scope_.storage: TEXT, JSON array, NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.scope_.lengthRange: 3–8 个元素（与 jobs.scope_json 同契约）
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.scope_.contract: 与 jobs.scope_json 完全同一契约：创建证明时原样复制 job.scope（scope: job.scope），不重新校验、不改写。元素只能是 8 个删除范围类别之一，无重复，必含 account、credentials、sessions。
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.scope_.enforcedAt: 继承 job.scope 的服务层校验；proof 写入口本身只经 jsonArray() 验 Array.isArray。
openItems: 与 jobs.scope_json 相同：deferred 类别的保留处理等 C5。

platform_identity_deletion_proofs.verifi.storage: TEXT, JSON array, NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.verifi.lengthRange: 恰好 7 个元素（断言数组）
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.verifi.contract: 对象数组，每元素 {name: 字符串, expected: 布尔/整数/字符串, actual: 布尔/整数/字符串, passed: 布尔}。断言名按 verification_mode 分两套，各 7 个：physical（account_row_absent / password_rows_absent / totp_rows_absent / passkey_rows_absent / session_rows_absent / challenge_rows_absent / entry_rows_absent）；logical（account_row_present / account_status_frozen / metadata_personal_fields_absent / password_rows_revoked / totp_rows_revoked / passkey_rows_revoked / session_no_active_rows）。expected/actual 的类型随断言而变（布尔、计数值、或 'not-active' 字符串）；passed 一律布尔。proof 颁发前校验断言数组非空（step 8），但不逐项校验元素形状。
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.verifi.enforcedAt: 由 buildReadbackAssertions() 生成；store 层 jsonArray() 只验 Array.isArray。
evidence: server/services/platform/portal-identity-deletion.mjs:660-676（step 8 取 assertions 发 proof、校验非空）
openItems: 无形状缺口；断言集合随 verification_mode 而定，writer 测试须两套都覆盖。

platform_identity_deletion_proofs.deferr.storage: TEXT, JSON array, NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.deferr.contract: 字符串数组，是 job.scope 减去已执行三类（account、credentials、sessions）后的剩余类别；元素只能是 5 个 deferred 类别之一，无重复。scope 恰好等于执行三类时为空数组 []。这是“暂缓处理、等 C5 决定”的范围记录，不是已执行范围。
platform_identity_deletion_proofs.deferr.enforcedAt: 服务层过滤生成（job.scope.filter 去掉执行三类）；store 层 jsonArray() 只验 Array.isArray。
openItems: deferred 类别的保留处理与期限等 C5 正式决定；词表本身已定。

platform_identity_deletion_tombstones.re.storage: TEXT, JSON array, NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
platform_identity_deletion_tombstones.re.contract: 字符串数组，当前代码固定为 ["financial_facts", "audit_events"]（常量 IDENTITY_DELETION_TOMBSTONE_RETAINED_CATEGORIES 原样展开写入）。含义：删除后仍保留的类别——财务事实与审计事件。store 层只验 Array.isArray，不验元素；词表今天只有这两项。
platform_identity_deletion_tombstones.re.enforcedAt: 常量展开（portal-identity-deletion.mjs:605）；store 层 jsonArray() 只验 Array.isArray。
